mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation (user_id, title, model, message_count, last_message_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{model}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_message_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET message_count = message_count + #{count}, last_message_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
